735260101.text: I should have hired someone to do this for me...

735260102.text: It's only the first test, but I have to cross mountains... This is torture!

735260103.text: Are you alright? You sound so weak...

735260104.text: #{NICKNAME}, she looks absolutely exhausted. Let's make her some food!

735260105.text: You cook up some piping-hot Fried Radish Balls and Steak at the nearby stove to help the stranger regain her strength...

735260107.text: You've got skills. However, the low-quality ingredients and spices resulted in a rather dry texture.

735260108.text: How can you be so picky at a time like this!? A full stomach is all that matters!

735260109.text: On the contrary! The harder times get, the more you must crave the luxuries of life! It's how you stay motivated!

735260110.text: The more your cash flow dries up, the bigger the loan you take out! It's the only way you can go all out and reverse your fortune!

735260111.text: That is the trade secret of turning the tides that I, the Phantom Toy Master Madiha, am bestowing upon you in return for your aid.

735260112.text: Ph—Phantom Toy Master? That sounds pretty cool! But looking like that, it doesn't seem right...

735260116.text: Let's see... you nearly died of hunger, you were so confused that you were talking to yourself, something about a test and hiring someone...

735260117.text: So obviously, you haven't finished your signature toy, right? It must be going really bad if you can't even remember to eat!

735260118.text: H—How could you say that! I won't be spoken of like that! My Barking Fox is in the final stage before production!

735260119.text: Once I figure out the flight envelope of the Barking Fox, I'll be able to write a manual that even Fungi can understand! Then with another loan for mass-production, I'll be able to turn a huge profit!

735260120.text: Flight envelope? What manual? Explain without the technical jargon so Paimon can understand!

735260121.text: It's easier to just show you!

735260122.text: Madiha pulls out a blue package from her bag and quickly inflates it.\nA moment later, a strange-looking toy appears and floats steadily in midair.

735260123.text: Is that your signature toy? It doesn't even look like a fox! You should just call it something like... Limited Edition Big-Eared Sunsettia Bomb: Blue Star!

735260124.text: And why is it called "Barking"? It doesn't even look like it's barking with laughter!

735260125.text: No, no, no! It's because its jet sounds like someone barking with laughter! Have a listen if you don't believe me!

735260126.text: (It emits an indescribably low howling sound. It would be stretching the bounds of the truth to even consider comparing it to "barking.")

735260127.text: #Where did she even hear that laughter from...? {NICKNAME}, Paimon thinks she may be barking mad...

735260128.text: Anyway, a small hot air balloon provides lift for the Barking Fox while the hidden jet provides propulsion, so it has excellent maneuverability.

735260129.text: Just imagine a toy that can fly nimbly! Forget kids, even adults wouldn't be able to resist its charms!

735269901.text: #Oh no! {NICKNAME}! There's someone lying on the ground over there, this looks bad! Let's go help her out!
